subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest component of natural gas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Methane.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

 
• Natural gas is a mixture of hydrocarbons.
 
• The main component of natural gas is methane.
 
• It contains mainly methane, ethane, propane, and butane.
 
• It is around 98% of the natural gas mixture.
 
• Natural gas is widely used as a fuel and a raw material.
 
• They are fossil energy sources that were generated years ago beneath the earth’s surface.
